                    ### Question
                    The most useful classification of vaccines is divided into live or attenuated vaccines and inactivated vaccines. Which of the following diseases can be prevented with a live attenuated vaccine?

Live attenuated vaccines contain weakened forms of the virus or bacteria, mimicking natural infections to stimulate the immune system and provide long-lasting immunity. Rubella can be prevented with a live attenuated vaccine.
